short_description: Building mixed-case pallets or moving full cases from storage to outbound, by arm or by automated system.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Robotic case picking and mixed-pallet building are sold commercially by fixed-automation vendors and a growing set of mobile-manipulation vendors, with paying customers in grocery and CPG. It is early commercial because deployments are still large capital projects with long lead times rather than repeatable installs.
advance_criteria: Repeatable installs quoted in months, not years
Vendors with more than ten production sites each
Mobile manipulators handling the case mix without human exception handling

incumbent_process.text: Manual case picking with pallet jacks and voice-directed picking.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Case picking is heavy, injury-prone manual work, which drives demand.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Grocery DCs have the highest case volumes and the earliest production systems.
